scope: Admin portal task recovery, draft preservation, background refresh stability, and independent post-save notifications

behavior.unknown_write_outcomes: Persist a staff-scoped pending-operation guard in sessionStorage. Block another request for that target until the operator checks current records and explicitly acknowledges having verified the outcome. Never automatically retry a write.
behavior.drafts: Staff- and task-scoped sessionStorage, 12-hour expiry, explicit field allowlists. Clear after confirmed success. Financial confirmations, files, signatures, passwords and authentication tokens are not draft fields.
draft_coverage: External payment amount, method and reference
External charge payment method and reference
Workflow-step notes and Stripe checkout amount
New-booking customer/vehicle selections, dates, times and delivery preferences
behavior.background_refresh: Defer list replacement while a task dialog is open. Drain deferred refresh when the last dialog closes. Re-read details invalidated during an in-flight read and expose a retryable error if records keep changing.
behavior.post_save: Confirmed operations return without waiting for secondary reads. External-payment admin notification runs separately with its own bounded wait.

validation.production_build: Passed using placeholder configuration in an isolated temporary output directory; this is not a deployable production artifact.
validation.browser: Chrome, isolated local fixtures using the actual payment dialog, draft hook, focus hook and recovery component. No production backend or payment connections.
browser_checks: Interrupted callback preserves amount/method/reference and re-enables controls
Full reload plus reopening restores draft, with confirmation unchecked
Recovery reads current mock record while unfinished task stays open
Keyboard Tab reaches recovery controls from payment submit button
Confirmed success closes task and clears draft
regression_checks: SDK stalled mutation returns an error without replay
Unknown and in-flight writes survive reload as guarded outcomes
Background list read cannot remove an open task
Notification can remain pending after successful payment task completion

audit_corrections: Made secondary-refresh error text neutral about whether the preceding save succeeded
Preserved uncertain-write guard for malformed JSON or proxy HTML acknowledgements
Prevented SDK retries from extending timed-out reads
Added keyboard access to recovery controls while modal is open and restricted handling to top modal
Updated existing test harnesses for draft hook and recovery owner without removing behavior assertions
limits: Checking current records does not automatically prove every interrupted operation has completed; the operator must review the outcome before acknowledging.
Drafts and pending guards persist in the same browser tab, not across devices. Storage-disabled browsers use in-memory request protection.
New-booking identity details, uploads and signatures must be supplied again after reload.
No live backend mutation or production deployment was performed.
